name: claim-quotes
title: Claim quotes
description: Each claim you make (fast setup, honest pricing, real support) backed by a customer quote and, where you have one, a number.
docs: Pass title and claims ({ id, claim, figure?: { value, label }, quote, name, role }); three or four read best (two work, five or more fall back to three columns). Each claim is an article with a heading, a description-list figure and a blockquote, so a screen reader hears the claim, the number, then the evidence. From 768px the articles share rows through a subgrid, so headings, figures, quotes and attributions line up across the row however long any quote is, and every number sits at the top of its row however many lines its label takes; a claim without a figure leaves its row empty rather than shifting the rest. On a phone every claim is a full-width block under its own rule. The block adds the quotation marks. Renders on the server.
